plugin.name: window-gaps
plugin._long: Puts windows on a half, a quarter or the whole screen, leaving room between them and the screen's edges. Games and listed programs fill their share.

option.name: gap
option._long: Pixels between tiled windows and between a tiled window and the screen's edge. 0 fills the share as grid does.

option.name: full_size_apps
option._long: App IDs (an X11 program's WM_CLASS) that get no gap, separated by spaces; * matches anything.

option.name: games_fill
option._long: Games get no gap: listed app IDs and programs started by Steam, umu or Lutris.

option.name: programs
option._long: App IDs of games, separated by spaces; * matches anything.

option.name: not_games
option._long: App IDs that never count as games, even when Steam or Lutris started them.

option.name: slot_bl
option._long: Puts the window in front on the lower left quarter.

option.name: slot_b
option._long: Puts the window in front on the lower half.

option.name: slot_br
option._long: Puts the window in front on the lower right quarter.

option.name: slot_l
option._long: Puts the window in front on the left half.

option.name: slot_r
option._long: Puts the window in front on the right half.

option.name: slot_tl
option._long: Puts the window in front on the upper left quarter.

option.name: slot_t
option._long: Puts the window in front on the upper half.

option.name: slot_tr
option._long: Puts the window in front on the upper right quarter.
